ui.sinDescarga: No download: there is no signed artefact yet.
ui.sinMedia: No data yet · be the first
ui.paqExplica: What you corrected, plus what your browser says about this machine. Nothing is sent on its own: you see it whole here, you copy it and you send it. The board is not open yet, so today the route is your own mail.
ui.paqCorreoCuerpo: Below I paste the package the page gave me.

bienvenida.util: Understand what your own machine can do, without reading documentation.
bienvenida.hoy: The rack already answers from the web, and the same character can run on your machine.
bienvenida.falta: The artefact does not exist: it must be trained and signed before it can be downloaded.
bienvenida.aportas: Tell us what you expected it to know and it did not. That trains the next version.

medidor.util: Know what your machine really delivers. Vendor figures are not measurements.
medidor.hoy: The measurement table already exists and is read on this very page.
medidor.falta: That the measurement is sent signed and joins an average that shows how many it holds.
medidor.aportas: Measure your machine and keep the result. It is sent when the board opens.

memoria.util: That what you learn lives in a file of yours, on your machine, not in a subscription.
memoria.hoy: The local database exists in the app; this line has no artefact yet.
memoria.falta: Decide which family fits: it asks for long context and images, and that is not Mistral.
memoria.aportas: Tell us what you would like to ask your own history.

reclamaciones.util: Complain without being passed around or told a rule that does not exist.
reclamaciones.hoy: The corpus is written: 200 real cases in two versions, to compare them.
reclamaciones.falta: It is still training, and it must be signed before anyone can download it.
reclamaciones.aportas: Tell us the complaint nobody resolved for you. That is what is missing.

business.util: Knowing whether an AI can be deployed at a company without anyone having to take a promise on trust.
business.hoy: Nothing yet: it is the sovereign node's priority line of research, declared before it exists.
business.falta: Crossing three things already measured apart: local cost against an external API, hallucination risk on critical tasks, and compliance of the deployed models.
business.aportas: Tell me what your audit asks for that you cannot prove today.

acta.util: Being able to show that a person looked at an answer before it went out, and that what they looked at is exactly what went out.
acta.hoy: Nothing drawn yet. What does exist is the chained log a record has to point at.
acta.falta: The split screen: the raw proposal on one side, the human edit on the other, and a button that seals. It is called a RECORD and not a signed contract on purpose: today it seals with a hash, and a hash shows the text did not change, not who approved it. The name goes up the day there is a signature with an owner.
acta.aportas: Tell me what you have to prove in your work, and to whom.

barra-tiempo.util: Seeing the exact span affected by what you are about to sign, instead of signing blind.
barra-tiempo.hoy: The substrate is built and tested: the event line returns the span of any interval, with who did each thing.
barra-tiempo.falta: Drawing it. Four zooms --day, week, month, year-- and the whole background, on all three surfaces. If the span cannot be drawn, the line was not linear yet.
barra-tiempo.aportas: Tell me what period you look at when you review something.
